title: Direct Experience World-Model Optimization: Learning the World Beyond Action Imitation
authors: Xiangcheng Zhan, Zirui Chen, Yicheng Zhao, Ziteng Gao, Shuo Yang

tldr.zh: DEWO 用执行转折点附近的成功／失败视频与成功动作继续训练 WAM，再根据进度反馈，在停滞时触发成功条件引导，调整动作生成。
tldr.en: DEWO continues WAM training on successful/failed visual futures and successful actions near interaction turning points, then uses progress feedback to activate success-conditioned action guidance when execution stalls.

evaluation_scope.zh: 沿失败轨迹恢复状态并采样后续执行，定位仍有成功机会到采样无成功的边界；有限采样无成功不等于物理不可恢复。真机由人检查失败、恢复可比配置并采样，不是全自动精确回溯。成功片段监督视频与动作，失败片段只监督视频／价值，屏蔽失败动作；按结果加成功／失败条件，不使用成对排序损失。FastWAM 后训练冻结骨干，更新文本交叉注意力 K/V 低秩适配器和价值头；DEWO-S 从视频／动作预训练组件构建 Joint WAM、训练全模型。进度头读取当前观测的分离梯度视频特征，回归折扣成功值；停滞时在生成过程组合普通／成功条件的动作预测场，非 Actor–Critic 更新或生成后关节角残差。FastWAM 仿真预测 32 步、执行 24 步后刷新；执行阶段不更新权重。五项 DexJoCo 任务上 FACT 为 64.5%→81.2%、FastWAM 为 80.7%→82.3%。Wuji／Sharpa 各四物体的真机 R0–R2 共 2,160 次评测，全网格为 20.6%→28.9%；51.0%→71.7% 仅为初始非零的 29 个位置，初始零成功的 43 个位置始终为零。代码、数据及预训练权重开放状态未核实。
evaluation_scope.en: Replay locates sampled recoverability boundaries; zero sampled successes do not prove irrecoverability. Hardware matching requires human diagnosis/restoration. Successes supervise video/actions; failures supervise video/value with action targets masked, without pairwise ranking. FastWAM adaptation freezes the backbone and trains text-attention K/V adapters plus a value head; DEWO-S trains a full Joint WAM from pretrained components. The head regresses discounted success from detached current-observation video features. Stalls trigger base/success-conditioned action-field guidance, not actor–critic updates or post-generation joint residuals. FastWAM simulation predicts 32 actions and executes 24 per replan; execution does not update weights. Five DexJoCo tasks improve FACT from 64.5% to 81.2% and FastWAM from 80.7% to 82.3%. Wuji/Sharpa hardware evaluation covers four objects and 2,160 R0–R2 trials. Full-grid success rises 20.6% to 28.9%; 51.0% to 71.7% applies only to 29 initially nonzero cells, while all 43 initially zero cells remain zero. Code/data/pretrained availability is unverified.
